hotel_name: Waldorf Astoria Dubai International Financial Centre

claims.text: The hotel is within 10 minutes of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and the Museum of the Future.

findings.quote: our urban retreat is within 10 minutes of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and The Museum of the Future

claims.text: The lobby is on the 18th floor.

findings.quote: its 18th-floor lobby

claims.text: Rooms and suites are residential in style, with brass and walnut finishes, marble bathrooms stocked with Aesop products, and floor-to-ceiling windows with 180-degree views of the Dubai skyline.

findings.quote: Discover our residential style rooms and suites. Each features chic brass and walnut finishes, marble bathrooms stocked with Aesop products, and floor-to-ceiling windows for 180-degree views of the Dubai skyline.

claims.text: Rooms are designed as a take on an upscale 1960s Manhattan apartment.

findings.quote: A fresh take on an upscale '60s style Manhattan apartment.

claims.text: Interiors were largely designed by the American firm Smallwood, Reynolds, Stewart, Stewart and Associates.

findings.quote: Interior design was largely by American firm Smallwood, Reynolds, Stewart, Stewart & Associates, Inc

claims.text: Bull & Bear, the signature steakhouse, has an Art Deco setting on Level 18 with Burj Khalifa views.

findings.quote: Our signature restaurant and steakhouse exemplifies culinary excellence, with expertly crafted dishes in an elegant Art Deco setting. Perched on Level 18 with breathtaking Burj Khalifa views

claims.text: Bull & Bear is modeled on the New York original, with dishes such as slow-cooked beef cheek, apple pie and a Waldorf salad.

findings.quote: The general idea in restaurant Bull & Bear is to replicate the original in New York, so there’s reassuring dishes to order like slow-cooked beef cheek and apple pie (and a Waldorf salad, naturally)

claims.text: Peacock Alley is a lounge and bar serving afternoon tea with sweet and savory bites.

findings.quote: An iconic lounge and bar perfect for elegant and informal gatherings alike.
Indulge in afternoon tea with sweet and savory bites.

claims.text: The fitness centre has Technogym cardio and strength-training equipment.

findings.quote: Cardio and strength-training equipment by Technogym®

claims.text: Guests can choose a pillow from a Pillow Menu, and the Personal Concierge escorts guests to their room on arrival.

findings.quote: When you arrive, your Personal Concierge will escort you to your room
Select the perfect pillow from our Pillow Menu

claims.text: The property displays works by Lebanese artist Imad Bechara.

findings.quote: works by Lebanese artist Imad Bechara

claims.text: The ground-floor conference rooms include a show kitchen for interactive sessions.

findings.quote: When it comes to the conference rooms on the ground floor
including a show-kitchen for more interactive sessions

claims.text: The spa's floatation pod offers a sensory deprivation experience with 600 kg of Epsom salt.

findings.quote: The floatation pod provides a sensory deprivation experience enhanced by 600 kg of Epsom salt

claims.text: St. Trop is a French Riviera-inspired rooftop lounge with a timber deck, pool, whirlpool and skyline views.

findings.quote: Savor a slice of the French Riviera. This chic rooftop lounge has a timber deck, pool, whirlpool, and breathtaking skyline views.

claims.text: The Cigar Lounge evokes the 1960s Mad Men era and is hosted by a Cigar Sommelier.

findings.quote: Transport yourself to the Mad Men-era in the 1960s at the Cigar Lounge. Join other aficionados in a journey hosted by our Cigar Sommelier.

claims.text: Corner suites have two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: The corner suites are the ones to bag with two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows.

claims.text: Every stay includes a dedicated Personal Concierge to help with excursions and special requests.

findings.quote: Your stay includes a dedicated Personal Concierge on hand to assist with excursions and special requests.

claims.text: The hotel is across the street from DIFC's main thoroughfare, slightly away from the heaviest bar-hopping footfall.

findings.quote: the Waldorf Astoria is across the street from the major thoroughfare of DIFC, so it feels ever-so-slightly away from the heavy footfall of bar-hopping Friday night city folk

claims.text: Room amenities should be ordered through the Personal Concierge at least 48 hours before arrival.

findings.quote: For more information and to order your room amenities, please contact your Personal Concierge a minimum of 48 hours before arrival.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the business district location may feel less resort-like.
